sources_note: Dress shares from Build-a-Dress Custom Dress Report 2026 (n≈2239 wedding designs). Bridesmaid length/silhouette cues from UK 2026 trend reports. Suit styles from 2026 groom/groomsmen guides (two-piece volume leader; three-piece comeback; midnight-blue tux trend).

dresses.name: A-line
dresses.why: Universally flattering; mix-and-match anchor for bridal parties.

dresses.name: Ball gown
dresses.why: Maximum volume and structure for formal ceremonies.

dresses.name: Fit & flare
dresses.why: Fitted through hip, flares below — photographs sculpted but walkable.

dresses.name: Mermaid
dresses.why: Body-skimming with dramatic flare at or below the knee.

dresses.name: Drop-waist / Basque
dresses.why: Elongates torso; modern regal line trending hard for 2026.

dresses.name: Empire
dresses.why: High waist under bust; soft, romantic, pregnancy-friendly.

dresses.name: Sheath / column
dresses.share_note: Top floor-length bridesmaid silhouette with A-line
dresses.why: Sleek minimal line; strong for modern / city / black-tie parties.

dresses.name: Bias slip
dresses.share_note: Old Hollywood / liquid satin editorial trend 2026
dresses.why: Bias-cut skim; satin movement; low embellishment.

dresses.name: One-shoulder
dresses.why: Asymmetric drama; works in mix-and-match parties.

dresses.name: Midi A-line
dresses.why: Outdoor, garden, barn — shorter hem, same A-line ease.

suits.name: Classic two-piece
suits.why: Volume leader — garden, beach, cocktail, most groomsmen looks.

suits.name: Three-piece (waistcoat)
suits.why: Groom often three-piece; groomsmen matching two-piece.

suits.name: Tuxedo · peak lapel
suits.why: Formal evening; peak lapel broadens shoulder read.

suits.name: Tuxedo · shawl / dinner jacket
suits.why: Continuous shawl lapel; velvet dinner jackets love this.

suits.name: Midnight-blue tuxedo
suits.why: 2026 reports: midnight blue often preferred over flat black under evening light.

suits.name: Linen beach two-piece
suits.why: Tan/sand/light navy; open collar; destination & coastal.

suits.name: Double-breasted
suits.why: Statement groom look; cream DB with navy tie is a coastal classic.

suits.name: Morning suit
suits.why: Church / cathedral daytime formal (tails or cutaway cue).

suits.name: Velvet dinner jacket
suits.why: Winter / evening differentiator; jewel or black velvet.

suits.name: Earth-tone three-piece
suits.why: Olive, brown, sand — outdoor/garden trend away from navy default.
